title: The Royal Fork
setup: White has just moved its rook to f1, leaving its king and its queen a knight leap apart.
hint: The white king and queen stand on two squares that a single knight square touches. Find it, then check it is safe.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Ne2+}} hits g1 and c1 on the same move, and nothing covers e2: the rook on f1 and the queen on c1 both look past it. {{Kh1}} is the only square left, and {{Nxc1}} takes the queen. King and queen a knight leap apart is the fork you check for first.
